newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FOCUS - PICK'S STRONG Q1 FIGURES SEEN CONTINUING.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS - PICK'S STRONG Q1 FIGURES SEEN CONTINUING.

text.p: Strong first quarter results by Hungary's leading meat processor Pick Szeged Rt could be sustained into the second and third quarters, an analyst said on Wednesday.

Pick reported on Wednesday an over 40 percent rise in its pre-tax profit in the first quarter of 1997, exceeding its target, and showed a consolidated pre-tax profit of 577.6 million forints for the first three months of 1997, as against 411.1 million in the same period of 1996.

"The good results stem from a higher than expected export sales and good financial items, with a fall in the level of credits," Andrea Dicso of Bank Austria-Girocredit told Reuters. "But the second quarter could be even better, as could be the third."
The group reported its sales rising to 6.68 billion forints from 5.94 billion, within which domestic sales rose 11.6 percent to 3.99 billion forints and exports by 13.9 percent to 2.69 billion.
Pick's domestic sales were marginally below its four billion forint plan, while its exports exceeded targets by 88 million.

Dicso said an improving domestic market as Hungary moves out of recession and new contracts in the United States gave reason for be optimistic about Pick's future and she said she was recommending Pick shares to investors.
"We definitely think it's a buy," she said.
